title: Animation Graph Node Editor with Blending
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js that implements an animation graph node editor with real-time animation blending on a 3D character preview.

## 3D Scene Setup
- Set up a Three.js scene with a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 1.5, 4) looking at origin.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light at (3, 5, 3) with intensity 0.8.
- Create a simple humanoid figure using primitive shapes: a box torso (0.6x0.8x0.3), a sphere head (radius 0.2) on top, two cylinder arms (radius 0.08, height 0.6) and two cylinder legs (radius 0.1, height 0.7). Group them as a single character group centered at origin on a grid floor (GridHelper size 10, divisions 10).
- The character should stand on y=0 with feet touching the ground.
- Add OrbitControls for the 3D viewport, restricted to the right 60% of the screen.

## Node Editor (Left Panel - 40% width)
- Create a DOM-based node editor panel on the left side with a dark background (#1a1a2e).
- Implement exactly 4 animation source nodes and 1 output node:
  1. **IdleNode**: Produces a gentle breathing/bobbing animation (subtle Y oscillation of torso, amplitude 0.02, frequency 1Hz).
  2. **WalkNode**: Produces a walking animation (legs alternate forward/back rotation ±25 degrees, arms swing opposite, torso bobs slightly, cycle at 1.5Hz).
  3. **WaveNode**: Produces a wave animation (right arm rotates up to -90 degrees Z and oscillates ±15 degrees, 2Hz).
  4. **JumpNode**: Produces a jump animation (character Y position oscillates 0 to 0.5 with a parabolic ease, legs tuck by rotating knees, 0.8Hz).
  5. **OutputNode**: The final blended output that drives the character.
- Each source node should be a draggable div (180x100px) with a colored header (Idle=#4a9eff, Walk=#ff9f43, Wave=#a55eea, Jump=#26de81), the node name, and a weight slider (0.0 to 1.0, step 0.01, default 0.0 except Idle defaults to 1.0).
- Each source node has a small circular output port (12px circle) on its right edge.
- The OutputNode (180x80px, header color #eb3b5a) is positioned on the right side of the node panel and has 4 input ports on its left edge, labeled I/W/Wv/J.
- Nodes can be dragged around the panel by their header. Track positions.

## Connection System
- Users can click an output port on a source node, then click an input port on the OutputNode to create a connection (draw an SVG line between them).
- Connections are colored matching the source node color.
- Only connected nodes contribute to the final blend. Initially, only IdleNode is connected.
- Right-clicking a connection line removes it.
- Draw connections as SVG paths (quadratic bezier) overlaid on the node panel.

## Animation Blending
- The OutputNode blends all connected animations using normalized weights: each connected node's weight divided by the sum of all connected weights.
- The blended animation is applied to the 3D character in real-time.
- Display the effective (normalized) weight of each connected node on the OutputNode.
- When no nodes are connected, the character stands in T-pose (default rest).

## Controls & HUD
- Add a Play/Pause button at the top of the node panel. Default state is Playing.
- Add a speed multiplier slider (0.1x to 3.0x, default 1.0x) below the play button.
- Add a 'Reset All' button that disconnects all connections, resets all weights to 0 (Idle to 1.0), and reconnects only Idle.
- Show an FPS counter and current animation time (seconds, 1 decimal) in the top-right of the 3D viewport.

## State Management
Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- `nodePositions`: object mapping node names ('Idle','Walk','Wave','Jump','Output') to {x, y} pixel positions in the panel.
- `weights`: object mapping node names to their slider values (raw, 0-1).
- `normalizedWeights`: object mapping connected node names to their effective normalized weights (should sum to ~1.0).
- `connections`: array of objects {from: 'nodeName', to: 'Output'} for active connections.
- `connectionCount`: number of active connections.
- `isPlaying`: boolean.
- `speedMultiplier`: number.
- `animationTime`: number (seconds elapsed in animation, respecting pause and speed).
- `characterY`: number (current Y position of character group).
- `rightArmRotationZ`: number (current Z rotation of right arm in degrees).
- `leftLegRotationX`: number (current X rotation of left leg in degrees).
- `blendMode`: 'normalized_weighted' (string constant).
- `activeAnimations`: array of strings listing currently connected and weighted>0 node names.
- `torsoPositionY`: number (current local Y offset of torso from rest).

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Normalized weights of all connected nodes must sum to 1.0 (±0.001). Character Y position must remain in [0, 0.6] range. Animation time must monotonically increase while playing and freeze while paused. All rotations must be bounded: leg X rotation in [-30, 30] degrees, arm Z rotation in [-105, 15] degrees. Speed multiplier must scale animation frequency linearly.
